purpose: Sanitized audit of excluded unidentified-target browser artifacts and retained integration evidence
excludedInputs: local lookup log containing unidentified database identifiers

identifierComparison.method: Extract UUIDs, batch/page/page_search query values, preproduction labels and card-route components from the excluded inputs into memory; compare values of at least eight characters, case-insensitively, against documentation and evidence text. Values are neither retained nor printed.
identifierComparison.scope: Readable tracked and untracked documentation and report files in the integration worktree; excludes the removed inputs. This working-tree scan preceded the final staged-index scan.

secretPatterns.scope: Staged documentation and report files at the initial review, excluding the three historical inputs

syntheticReport.note: Token-named fields refer to model token usage and limits.

limitations: Pattern and exact-value matching cannot prove that all private values are absent.
The original target was not identified; its report and logs are not evidence of the later local synthetic run.
The historical candidate input fingerprint describes the pre-repair candidate, not the repaired integration tree.

finalStagedScan.scope: All paths in the staged diff, including documentation, reports, source and configuration. The large lockfile was scanned in consecutive 1000-line chunks.
finalStagedScan.limitations: Exact-value and pattern matching do not prove the absence of every possible private value.
